---
title: Reveal.js slide level
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-level: 3
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The filter reads slide-level, so a header at that level stays a slide and a header below it goes into a veiled Div.
    revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<section id="one"[^>]*data-veil-group="t"', '<div class="veil" data-veil-group="s">\s*<h4 id="sub"']
        - ['<div class="veil" data-veil-group="t"', '<section id="sub"', '<h4[^>]*data-veil-group']
---

## Part

### One {#one .veil group="t"}

Text MKONE.

#### Sub {#sub .veil group="s"}

Sub text MKSUB.
